messages:
meera: Quick heads-up — console preview numbers are undercounting compared to raw ingest after the sampling-sidecar canary. Noticed ~30% lower tokens in per-route preview.
kevin: Confirmed. Console only reads post-enrich metering events; when client/edge sampling happens earlier we never get the dropped tokens in that stream.
jess: Is the sampling decision in the sidecar currently opaque to the control plane? I thought we were emitting a sampled=false tag but maybe not.
rafael: Sidecar emits sample_decision but we drop it during route-normalize step if it's not in the new proto. There's a transform that strips unknown fields.
meera: Right — that's the telemetry-contract gap. Two fixes: 1) restore sample_decision into the canonical event (fast). 2) expose sampling gate in console so product teams can see and tweak (bigger UX/security question).
kevin: Exposing the gate in console worries me. Non-privileged users toggling sampling will change billing projections and could be abused.
jess: Agreed. We should avoid making a direct toggle. Maybe a read-only view + request flow (RBAC + change request) or a staged rollout button for admins only.
eng-console: @jess we have a lightweight UX pattern: show current sampling profile, last change, and a CTA to open a config PR. No inline toggles.
rafael: From infra side, the minimal immediate change is to keep sampling decisions in the canonical event and add a boolean field: "sample_origin": "edge|sidecar|server". That unblocks telemetry.
meera: Sounds good. For the dashboard we also need to recalc preview-to-invoice mapping. Suggest adding a reconciliation column that shows quota_estimated_vs_metered.
kevin: Docs + alert: if preview delta > 5% fire an alert to billing-signal channel. Otherwise we'll get surprises next invoice run.
jess: Ownership: rafael will land the event-schema patch (small transform). eng-console will add a read-only sampling panel for admins. meera will draft the alert runbook.
infra-bot: deploy started for metering-transform v2 -> canary
meera: thanks. Can we aim to ship the telemetry fix to canary today and console change early next week? :thumbsup:
kevin: +1
rafael: on it, will post PR link once ready.
